design_philosophy: Institutional European finance meets modern clean SaaS. Strict, authoritative, document-like paper aesthetic. High-contrast typography for critical data parsing. Avoid all AI-slop purple gradients and generic SaaS curves. Everything feels like a legally binding, eIDAS-compliant digital document.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight text-primary
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-primary

rules: Data codes (RSM-YYYY-XXXX) and financial figures must use IBM Plex Mono.
Overlines must be uppercase with 0.2em tracking.
Headings must use tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. The grid must be visible.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-0 border-l border-t border-border
rules: Use 1px solid borders to create structural layouts.
Avoid soft drop shadows. Use hard 1px borders or solid 4px offset shadows for depth.
Cards and sections must feel like modular paper documents.

kpi_cards.structure: Flat background, 1px border, 0px radius. No shadow. Minimalist data presentation.
kpi_cards.classes: bg-white border border-border p-6 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

status_badges.verified: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#ECFDF5] text-[#065F46] border border-[#34D399] rounded-none
status_badges.anonymous: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#F1F5F9] text-[#475569] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-none
status_badges.pending: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#FFFBEB] text-[#92400E] border border-[#FCD34D] rounded-none

marketplace_cards.structure: Rectangular grid item, high information density. Focus on typographic hierarchy.
marketplace_cards.classes: relative border border-border bg-white p-6 hover:border-primary transition-all flex flex-col gap-4
marketplace_cards.header: flex justify-between items-start border-b border-border pb-4

horizontal_timeline.line: absolute top-4 left-1/2 w-full h-[2px] bg-border -z-10
horizontal_timeline.node_completed: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm z-10
horizontal_timeline.node_active: w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-primary bg-white text-primary flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm z-10
horizontal_timeline.node_pending: w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-border bg-white text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm z-10
horizontal_timeline.label: mt-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-center

digital_nca_modal.content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] w-full max-w-2xl bg-white border-2 border-primary shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#0B132B] p-8 z-50 rounded-none
digital_nca_modal.typography: Feels like a legally binding document. Serif headers, mono data fields, stark white background.
digital_nca_modal.signature_area: border-2 border-dashed border-border p-8 text-center mt-6 bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer hover:border-primary transition-colors

chat_bubbles.tab_active: px-4 py-2 border-b-2 border-primary font-bold text-primary text-sm uppercase tracking-wider
chat_bubbles.tab_inactive: px-4 py-2 text-muted-foreground text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:text-primary transition-colors
chat_bubbles.bubble_broker: bg-primary text-white p-4 rounded-none max-w-[80%] self-end
chat_bubbles.bubble_client: bg-slate-100 text-primary p-4 rounded-none max-w-[80%] self-start border border-border

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-primary border border-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-colors

images.description: Modern skyscrapers reflected in a calm river under blue sky - Use for landing page hero, combined with a stark white gradient overlay for text readability.
Contemporary skyscrapers reaching for the sky in Frankfurt - Can be used for auth pages or platform loading screens.
Professional male executive at a desk - Use for Broker marketplace profile mockups.
Professional female executive - Use for Broker marketplace profile mockups.
Close-up of paper texture - Use very subtly (opacity 2-5%) as a background texture overlay to enforce the 'institutional document' feel.

icons.rules: Use stroke-width 1.5. Icons should feel like technical schematic symbols. Do not use filled versions unless indicating a selected state.

motion.philosophy: Minimalist and precise. Micro-interactions for feedback. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.reveal: transition-all duration-500 ease-out (used for revealing anonymous data)

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. All text on pure white must be #0B132B (Navy) or #475569 (Slate).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app toggles between ES and EN. Default to ES.
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' with rounded corners. Override the radius to 0px across all Shadcn components via Tailwind config or class names.
Use standard HTML tables with strict border-collapse for data grids, or grid layouts with explicit borders.
Implement the 3 dimensions for ratings using a minimal star component (lucide-star) colored with the brand's primary color, not yellow.
Implement the anonymity logic clearly: a lock icon, a blurred text class, and a verification badge are paramount for the UX.
The digital NCA modal must look like a physical document—white background, serif headers, mono text for the cryptographic ID.
DO NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the exact URLs provided in the media.images section of this JSON.
